name: Chick-fil-A Spicy Deluxe Chicken Sandwich (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Marinated in spicy pepper blend and dill pickle brine, dipped in milk/egg wash, breaded with cayenne and paprika spices, pressure-fried in peanut oil, and topped with pepper jack cheese. A guaranteed severe mucosal irritant.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID during flares, strictures, or active proctitis. The capsaicin and hot oil provoke immediate intestinal burning and urgency.
